seed_formula: uint64 little-endian first 8 SHA-256 bytes of UTF8 master|scope|1-based repetition|component
coupling: level-independent permutation; first floor(.10*N) nested inside first floor(.20*N); shared full-length feature sign and category uniforms across levels; streams independent across features and scopes
signs: independent Bernoulli(.5) per record and feature, before level selection
semantic_selection: complete holdout uniformly without replacement; eligibility never changes selection

metric_definitions.movement: perturbed minus original probabilities; absolute summaries across all records; changed-record supplement
metric_definitions.rank: Spearman average ranks; constant inputs undefined
metric_definitions.RGR: authentic SAFE rga(original probabilities, perturbed probabilities), point estimates only; model-specific magnitude normalization
metric_definitions.calibration: 10 equal-width bins, count-weighted ECE using established reliability_bins
metric_definitions.zero_denominators: precision and F1 follow repository zero convention; recall/specificity undefined when their class absent
metric_definitions.direction: higher RGR/Spearman/AUC/AP/accuracy/precision/recall/specificity/F1 better; higher absolute movement/flip/error scores greater instability or error; signed movement has no good direction

aggregation: compute nonlinear metrics and baseline deltas per repetition, then paired GBM-LR, then mean; sample SD ddof=1 separately; deterministic SD undefined, not fabricated

bootstrap.sex: subset each globally sampled complete group resample; composition varies; never force exact strata
bootstrap.conditioning: frozen models and saved tail-swap realization or 30 saved semantic realizations; no re-perturbing in bootstrap

safe_identity.github_comparison: core identical; fairness/utils differ only in whitespace/newline
safe_identity.parity_return: string containing max(group RGA) - min(group RGA)
safe_identity.group_order: training SEX value_counts order; no privileged/unprivileged assignment
safe_identity.yhat_behavior: validated as input; subgroup probabilities recomputed through adapter
safe_identity.input_index_behavior: package resets inputs; supply aligned positional order
safe_identity.robustness_identity: Installed 0.8.3 module inspected locally and SHA-256 pinned; no commit equality claimed

limits: synthetic research choices, not measured error frequencies; layers not severity-equivalent
